description: Boot completion verification — hard gate, all steps must pass

rules.name: all_prior_steps_complete
rules.reason: All 7 prior steps must report complete status
rules.retry_instruction: Step-07 output is missing the 'steps_verified' field. Re-execute step-07 to verify that all prior steps have completed, and populate this field with a summary of each step's completion status.

rules.name: no_step_failures
rules.reason: Must track failed steps (empty list if none failed)
rules.retry_instruction: The 'failed_steps' field is missing. Re-execute step-07 to check for any failed steps in the boot sequence and populate this field with a list of failed steps (or empty list if all passed).

rules.name: state_yaml_complete
rules.reason: state.yaml must be marked status: complete
rules.retry_instruction: The 'state_status' field is missing. Re-execute step-07 to mark state.yaml with status: complete and populate this field with confirmation that the state file was updated.

rules.name: session_index_written
rules.reason: Session index must be written for future reference
rules.retry_instruction: The 'session_index_path' field is missing. Re-execute step-07 to write or update the session index file and populate this field with the path to the written file.

rules.name: no_guardrail_escalations
rules.reason: Should report count of escalations from prior steps (0 if none)
rules.retry_instruction: The 'escalation_count' field is missing. Re-execute step-07 to count any escalations in the eval record and populate this field with the count (0 if no escalations).
